reviews.text:
My experience with Groomie has been deeply disappointing and problematic. In 2024, I ordered a product for myself and immediately opted out of their subscription service. At that time, there were no further charges, and the issue did not arise until after I purchased a kit for my brother in December 2025 and again opted out.

Despite these clear actions, Groomie falsely claimed I signed up as a new subscriber. They continued to charge my account two more times after my opt-outs. I reached out to them, and once they acknowledged my opted-out status, they refunded my money. However, in April 2026, they again claimed I signed up as a new subscriber an assertion that is completely false, as I have been a member since 2024.

Adding to the concern, Groomie claims they shipped me a product I neither ordered nor received. They are unable to provide any details about the mailing or current location of the product.

This pattern of deceptive billing, misinformation, and lack of transparency is unacceptable. Groomie’s practices are highly questionable, and their inability to substantiate their claims or resolve these issues raises serious doubts about their integrity. I strongly advise potential customers to exercise caution and consider alternative vendors. My experience has been nothing short of a scam, and I hope others are warned before engaging with this company.

I don’t know how the ratings are so high but I took my schnauzer to this groomer after reading the reviews. I notified the groomer that my puppy has extremely sensitive ears and prone to hematomas. She said that she would notify the groomer. I picked my dog up and his poor ears are bald and are so irritated. They paid no mind to my request. I would definitely not recommend this groomer. My boy is so uncomfortable and now I need to take him to the vet to see if there is anything I can do to make him comfortable.
My puppy smells so good and his trim looks great!

I have been taking my dog to Groomies for 2 years. His groomer, Ashley is the best. She takes care of my pup once a month. She is great with my dog. He always comes out of Groomies happy, handsome and smelling good. A highly recommend Ashley. Give her a shot. You will be happy with the results.I love Groomies.

The best groomer money can buy. We took our dog Kaner here for 6 years and I can confidently say these are the best groomers we could have ever asked for. They treat all of their dogs with immense care and love and the grooming itself was immaculate every appointment. Groomies also goes the extra mile in terms of ensuring the dogs are extremely safe, with multiple processes in place to prevent escapes. Sadly we recently moved and can no longer use Groomies, but I cannot recommend them enough and we will always be grateful for how much love and care they showed Kaner over the years.

Mitch and I are first Timers!!!
The staff is extremely friendly and Mitch looks absolutely amazing !!!

This is a proper cut!!!

We found our place !!!! Thank you so much !!!
Fantastic job and took great care of my little pup!! The workers are so sweet and I felt great leaving him in their care and he looked amazing and so happy when picking up - highly recommend!

We have been using Groomies for almost 2 years now and they take wonderful care of our pup, Bogey. He has seen multiple groomers (we never specify) and he always looks great when he's done. We were on a waiting list for a while to get in, but now that we are repeat clients, it is very easy to book (usually via text, 2-4 weeks out depending on time of year), and they book by time slot so your pet isn't hanging around in a cage all day waiting for their turn. They always text when he's around 15 minutes from being done. Bogey is always relaxed any happy when he comes home, which is a triumph for a pup who doesn't like much to be groomed. Everyone is always a pleasure to interact with - I wouldn't hesistate to recommend Groomies!

Ashley is AMAZING. We were so nervous sending our 7-month-old Bernedoodle pup to his first real haircut. I totally helicopter-mom’d it - I came in with a full list of notes for what I wanted Duke’s cut to look like. Ashley and the Groomies team NAILED IT! They left him long and made him look so fresh and clean! I cannot tell you how many people have stopped us on the street to tell us how cute & fluffy he looks. Some have even said, “wow, that dog has a great haircut!” In addition to his great cut, Groomies is so easy to communicate with - they text with updates throughout your dog’s appointment, and are so easy to schedule with. We are now officially Groomies fanatics, and can’t wait to keep sending Duke here for regular coat maintenance. Thank you Groomies team!!
Yoshi loves to go to Groomies and always looks fabulous!!!

Groomies always does a fantastic job at tackling the fur explosion of my very energetic husky (Atlas). Ashley is patient with Atlas and is really good at reading body language for signs of stress or overstimulation and ensures he has a positive experience each appointment. Thank you Groomies!
Only came here for a quick walk in service but they were so efficient, I was in and out in less than 15 min.
Been taking our dog here since 2020. There isn’t a groomer I would trust more. They are always super nice, quick, and do an amazing job!
